remarks: Nestled on a beautifully landscaped acre, this property boasts lush perennials and greenery, a luxurious heated gunite pool, and a spacious patio perfect for outdoor fun - all just moments away from the vibrant heart of New Canaan and the convenience of Stamford. Rebuilt in 1963 on the historic grounds of an 1800s estate, this home masterfully preserves its original charm with features like wide-planked wood floors, exposed wood beams, classic 12-over-12 windows, stone walls and 3 stunning fireplaces. The main level is perfect for entertaining with a spacious living room featuring an expansive fireplace and built-ins, a magnificent dining room with its own fireplace and beehive oven, and a family room with vaulted ceiling, built-in bookcases, French doors to the patio and an additional fireplace. The gourmet eat-in kitchen is equipped with double Viking ranges, abundant counter space and ample storage. Upstairs, discover a generous master suite with an ensuite bath and a dressing room that can easily accommodate office space or a nursery. Two additional bedrooms share a convenient Jack and Jill bath. The sunny third floor offers flexible space, perfect for a playroom, office, or guest bedroom. A finished lower level with wine cellar and playroom, completes this one-of-a-kind home. Ideally located minutes from the Merritt, Metro North, New Canaan, and just a short drive to downtown Stamford, this property is the perfect blend of secluded luxury and urban convenience.
